narrative: A primary school teacher, born in Hama in central Syria but living and teaching in Damascus, traveled to Berlin via Sudan, Egypt, Libya, Italy and Austria, at a cost of almost $5,000. The sea crossing between Libya and Italy lasted nine hours at night, with about 200 people on board. His wife and baby son were still in Syria, and he hoped to bring them over as soon as he could. He arrived in Berlin in the spring.
